cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: I Need Your Blessing
cards.instruction: Get approval from someone whose opinion still carries emotional weight, even when permission is unnecessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Mum, we signed the lease. Say it's good news before I open the wine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You don't need my permission to move in with Sam.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. I know. I still want my mother to be pleased.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm pleased for you. I'm still getting used to Sam.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you toast both of us? I want to remember you welcoming our home, not just tolerating my address.

mechanism: A directs a properly inclusive celebratory toast, correcting permission and partial maternal approval into emotional endorsement of an already signed shared home.
confusable: D57 seeks public standing through courtesy; D76 seeks personally meaningful parental blessing despite no permission requirement.
comparison: Museum alternative needs craft-parent confidence in work; lease alternative needs mother welcome both child and partner.
seedUse: Mum, signed lease, Sam, wine and both-person toast derive from D76-b; S03 adds precise completed-task and toast wording corrections.
